name: Hitozuma Senmon Inraku Massage
original_name: 人妻専門淫堕マッサージ
source:
Two married women go gonzo to the touch of a hentai massage therapist.

Haruka Sakuragi had a high society air of maturity.
Manami Yuzuki was more of a free spirit. You wouldn't know she was married.
These two very different women lived in the same apartment bloc.

One day they tried out the local massage parlor,
which turned out to be managed by a handsy pervert.

At first the wives were shocked and repulsed.
However his technique won them over, awakening a pleasure in their bodies.
Then it progressed from massage to something much bolder.

translation:
两名已婚妇女在无尽按摩治疗师的抚摸下发生了奇闻趣事。

樱木遥有着上流社会成熟的气质。
柚月真奈美更具有自由精神。你不会知道她已经结婚了。
这两个截然不同的女人住在同一栋公寓里。

有一天他们尝试了当地的按摩院，
原来是由一个手巧的变态管理的。

起初，妻子们感到震惊和排斥。
然而他的技术赢得了他们的青睐，唤醒了他们身体的快感。
然后它从按摩发展到更大胆的事情。
